svg.aria-label: 045° · Products — Software for Afghan small businesses
svg.title: 045° · Products — Software for Afghan small businesses

g.text: The till keeps selling when the power goes out.
Pharmacies, clinics, shops, land agents and language schools. Every app installs from the browser, keeps its
records on the device, works without internet or electricity and syncs when the line comes back. Licences, trials
and payments run through one hub, FY Merkez.
